filter_followup.scope: Read-only production audit plus scratch-only NativeCanvas Filter leaf prototypes. No product/header/benchmark fixture edits. Same deterministic visible high mixed world;20warmup+30measuredframes. Firstresolve evaluatescurrentchangedpages;secondresolve repeats identicalcanvas with no newprefixbuilds. No FPS claim.

variants.baseline: Original Filter and allocating Page::prefix; instrumentation only.
variants.reuseprefix: Reuse unique stale AreaPrefix buffer; preserve shared immutable prefixes; pixel sums recomputed exactly.
variants.fused: One RGB integral coordinate evaluation per corner instead of per channel.
variants.lookup: Dense page-pointer lookup table per Filter instead of canvas.pages_.find in each pixel fragment.
variants.all: Unique prefix buffer reuse+fused integrals+dense lookup.

conclusions: Current high mixed resolve does one prefix rebuild per changed native page, with no repeated rebuilds for identical output. Active prefix cache is below budget.
Most first-resolve time is genuinely rebuilding current RGB sums across about15.04million changed native pixels; second identical resolve isolatesabout4–5ms of query/filter overhead.
Unique stale prefix buffer reuse removes918allocations but observed gain isabout1.9ms in one paired observation; not a20ms allocator bug.
Fused RGB coordinates/dense lookup have small or inconsistent first-resolve gains in these samples. Do not treat six sequential variant medians as a robust total-frame speedup.
No production code, shared workload header, product binary or active CI changed for these probes.

additional_source_only_finding.finding: No-base changed pages reset RGBA/float-Z/native-Z in the owner loop, then nativeBase() clears the two depth planes again. The high mixed workload has a source-confirmed redundant90,243,072depth-write bytes/update at918changedpages.
additional_source_only_finding.status: Source audit only; scratch initialization variants prepared but not needed for the completed Filter audit; no product patch proposed as verified.
